metadata.question: Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji in December 2020 lower than in any other December from 2005 to 2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) data for Mount Fuji - Compare December 2020 vs all Decembers from 2005-2015 - Use Landsat data (Landsat 5/7/8) which has bands for NDSI calculation - NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) - Mount Fuji location: approximately 35.36°N, 138.73°E 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want valid snow measurements - Use cloud masking for Landsat data 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDSI for December 2020 - Calculate mean NDSI for each December 2005-2015 - If Dec 2020 NDSI < ALL Decembers (2005-2015), answer A - If Dec 2020 NDSI >= ANY December (2005-2015), answer B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Mount Fuji location const mtFuji = ee.Geometry.Point([138.73, 35.36]).buffer(5000); // Function to calculate NDSI for Landsat function addNDSI(image) { const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B6']).rename('NDSI'); // Green and SWIR1 return image.addBands(ndsi); } // Cloud mask for Landsat 5/7 function maskCloudsL57(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Cloud mask for Landsat 8 function maskCloudsL8(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to get mean NDSI for a December async function getDecemberNDSI(year) { const startDate = `${year}-12-01`; const endDate = `${year}-12-31`; let collection; if (year <= 2011) { // Use Landsat 5 collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(mtFuji) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskCloudsL57) .map(addNDSI); } else if (year <= 2013) { // Use Landsat 7 collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(mtFuji) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskCloudsL57) .map(addNDSI); } else { // Use Landsat 8 collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(mtFuji) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskCloudsL8) .map(addNDSI); } const size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { return { mean: null, count: 0, size: 0 }; } const meanImage = collection.select('NDSI').mean(); const stats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: mtFuji, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); return { mean: stats['NDSI_mean'], count: stats['NDSI_count'], size: size }; } // Get December 2020 NDSI console.log("Analyzing December 2020..."); const dec2020 = await getDecemberNDSI(2020); console.log(`Dec 2020: Images=${dec2020.size}, Pixels=${dec2020.count}, NDSI=${dec2020.mean}`); if (dec2020.size === 0) { console.log("No data for December 2020"); console.log("C1"); return; } if (dec2020.count === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for December 2020"); console.log("C2"); return; } if (dec2020.mean === null || dec2020.mean === undefined || isNaN(dec2020.mean)) { console.log("Invalid calculation for December 2020"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Get NDSI for each December 2005-2015 const years = []; for (let year = 2005; year <= 2015; year++) { years.push(year); } let allValid = true; let dec2020IsLowest = true; for (const year of years) { const decStats = await getDecemberNDSI(year); console.log(`Dec ${year}: Images=${decStats.size}, Pixels=${decStats.count}, NDSI=${decStats.mean}`); if (decStats.size === 0 || decStats.count === 0 || decStats.mean === null || isNaN(decStats.mean)) { allValid = false; continue; } if (dec2020.mean >= decStats.mean) { dec2020IsLowest = false; } } if (!allValid) { console.log("Missing data for some years"); console.log("C1"); return; } console.log(`\nDec 2020 NDSI (${dec2020.mean.toFixed(3)}) is lowest: ${dec2020IsLowest}`); if (dec2020IsLowest) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
